name: @tessera/respond-widget
description: The embeddable <tessera-respond> custom element: renders the CIP-179 answering UI from a survey definition + responder identity, validates and (for sealed surveys) timelock-encrypts in-widget, and emits a ready-to-attach label-17 payload back to the host. Framework-agnostic; wallets, chain reads, and submission stay host-side.
